scholarships.title: NUS Undergraduate Scholarship (NUS Scholarships for Freshmen, Singapore Citizens)
scholarships.official_source: National University of Singapore, Office of Admissions

eligibility: Applying for admission to a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NUS
For the NUS Scholarships tiers, the degree programme must exclude Dentistry, Medicine and Music
Have strong leadership qualities and potential
Have a good co-curricular activities record
Possess outstanding Singapore-Cambridge GCE A Level, local Polytechnic Diploma, International Baccalaureate Diploma, NUS High School Diploma or equivalent qualifications
Transfer applicants from local or overseas universities are not eligible
Matriculating in the year of application for the donated scholarships listed alongside
existing.eligibility_summary: Singapore Citizens applying for admission to a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NUS, with strong leadership qualities and potential, a good co-curricular activities record, and outstanding Singapore-Cambridge GCE A Level, local Polytechnic Diploma, International Baccalaureate Diploma, NUS High School Diploma or equivalent qualifications. Transfer applicants from local or overseas universities are not eligible, and the tiers exclude Dentistry, Medicine and Music.
benefits: Subsidised tuition fees after the MOE Tuition Grant subsidy
Guaranteed one-semester Student Exchange Programme placement at an NUS overseas partner university, not applicable to Medicine and Dentistry
Priority for on-campus accommodation in the first two years, for Halls and Houses in Year 1 and Halls, Houses and Residences in Year 2
coverage: Subsidised tuition fees after the MOE Tuition Grant subsidy (NUS Undergraduate Scholarship tier)
Guaranteed Student Exchange Programme placement of one semester with an NUS overseas partner university (NUS Undergraduate Scholarship tier)
Priority for on-campus accommodation for the first two years of undergraduate study, subject to eligibility and a complete hostel application in the first housing application window each year
Bond-free scholarship status for the NUS Undergraduate Scholarship tier
requirements: Submit the NUS admission application before the scholarship application
Maintain a GPA of at least 3.50 each semester, or grades within the top 80% of the cohort for Dentistry, Law and Medicine recipients, plus good conduct, for the scholarship to be renewed
Do not concurrently hold any other scholarship, fellowship, bursary, grant, award, allowance, waiver or free aid without prior approval from the University
Be available for selection interviews, which run from late March onwards, as the application is withdrawn if a scheduled interview is missed without valid reason
documents: Supporting documents including the co-curricular activities record, uploaded at the Applicant Portal
One Referee Recommendation Form submitted online separately by the applicant's Junior College, polytechnic or high school principal or tutor
An admission application to NUS, which must be submitted before the scholarship application
application_method: Submit an application for admission to NUS first
Submit one online scholarship application with supporting documents through the Applicant Portal between 1 February and 19 March 2027
Have the Junior College, polytechnic or high school principal or tutor submit the Referee Recommendation Form online
Attend the selection interview if shortlisted, and check the Applicant Portal for the outcome by late May
existing.selection_notes: Applicants are assessed on the strength of their application and their performance in the scholarship selection interview if shortlisted. Applicants whose first choice is Dentistry, Medicine or Law and who are shortlisted for those admission tests are assessed on those instead, and may face further scholarship selection interviews. Shortlisted applicants are informed by email, interviews run from late March, and outcomes are notified by late May. NUS reserves the right to award no scholarship if there are no candidates of sufficient merit.
existing.best_fit: Singapore Citizen school leavers with strong A Level, polytechnic, IB or NUS High School results, a strong co-curricular and leadership record, seeking a full-time NUS undergraduate degree outside Dentistry, Medicine and Music.
existing.notes: The database row bundles six separate NUS awards that NUS publishes as distinct scholarships with different benefit packages: NUS Global Merit Scholarship, NUS Merit Scholarship, NUS Undergraduate Scholarship, NUS AI Talent Scholarship, NUS Sports Scholarship and NUS Performing & Visual Arts Scholarship. Only the NUS Undergraduate Scholarship tier's own benefit list was read in full. If the scholar withdraws or terminates the scholarship prematurely, NUS reserves the right to require repayment of all scholarship monies disbursed.
existing.duration: Tenable for the normal candidature period of the degree, renewed every semester
existing.application_period: 1 February to 19 March 2027 for AY2027 intake. One common online scholarship application covers all the NUS Scholarships tiers and the donated scholarships listed on the same page.
existing.deadline_display: Application for NUS Scholarships for AY2027 commences from 1 February to 19 March 2027. Only one common scholarship application is required.
